gate: B7 (GAME_PLAN_ACTION_RPG.md §13): bound cost and preserve state

reference_machine.note: plan §13 reference machine; the battery runs on exactly this host

resident_native_working_set.note: repeated construction (admit -> weld -> chambers/valve/heat/piston -> step -> save -> re-admit) must reach a bounded plateau, not grow per cycle (gallery item 11)

vram_note: the GPU is shared with other processes; the bound tolerates their noise while still catching a per-cycle VRAM leak from the overlay re-upload lane
telemetry_note: the two routine per-tick reads (/tick_b2_state, /tick_b2_process) stay far below the bound; the full-state save document is an EXPLICIT route and its round trips are counted (round_trips) - routine = zero

physical_clock.note: dedicated steady_clock thread; catch-up after a stall is bounded and every bound applied is counted (catchup_clamps), never silently absorbed (plan: fixed simulation clock independent of rendering; slow frames reported)

presentation.note: engine's own 5 s frame-time window (ft ms avg) must sit inside the 60 FPS presentation target while the B2 scene is live

topology_pools.note: fixed caps, self-named refusals at the cap, usage reported every tick in state.pools; the weld cap equals C(6,2) so the pool is bounded by construction
